deferredStmPrototype.reason: A multiple store counts as one instruction but transfers four words. Hardware cycle benefit against four STR stores remains unmeasured.

originalScan.method: Aligned ARM words in whole payload; candidates include data. Only the limited direct reset/FatFs graph establishes reachability. No original routine removed.

sampleIo.profileWindows: Boot: fixed ten-second model window. Import: menu open plus confirm/three seconds. Export: menu/confirm plus five seconds. Counts include UI, scheduling and background work.
sampleIo.filesystemSpanDefinition: Inclusive ARM instructions while each call is in progress, including scheduling and drivers. This does not isolate real card waiting or CPU cycles.
sampleIo.result: No VM fill calls during import/export; sample metadata, filesystem requests/results and SD commands equal. Identical exported files with known zero DSP stand-in audio do not prove audio fidelity. Boot savings include plugin runtime initialization, not a faster sample transfer.

vmCopy.scope: Native VM load; no firmware, card or sample audio
vmCopy.copyRegisters: r6 source, r10 destination, r0 index, r9 length; r1 byte scratch
vmCopy.copyHelperSelected: Retain local byte copy. Source/destination alignment is not assumed; optional SysEx helper has another owner, while libc would add firmware dependency to standalone VM. No approved code-growth budget beyond the selected fill routine.
vmCopy.eventArgsCopy: Up to four 32-bit arguments in existing word loop; not a byte-fill bottleneck.
